name: Roshutsu no Kaikan
source:
Mika Adachi was an average 2nd year student who did well in school. One day when a molester assaulted her, she was horrified to be ignored by the other passengers. She cried for helpbut everyone just stared while trying not to stare. Nobody helped.
Nobody helped. It was humiliating and thrilling at the same time. When it was done the atmosphere was muggy with sexual arousal, and Mika herself was sopping with juice. She loved it.
She loved it.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100123.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
足立美香是一名成绩不错的普通高二学生。一天，她在电车上遭到色狼骚扰，却惊恐地发现其他乘客全都视而不见。她大声求救，可众人只是偷偷打量，没有一个人伸出援手。

没有任何人帮助她。那种体验既屈辱，又令人兴奋。结束时，车厢里弥漫着令人窒息的情欲，而美香自己也已湿透。

她喜欢这种感觉，喜欢得无法自拔。
